title: Duel Decks: Elves vs. Goblins: card flavor text

entities.name: Elves
entities.description: Elves of Llanowar and Lys Alana; a culture of beauty with castes and long memories.

entities.name: Imperious Perfect
entities.description: The most beautiful elf, worshipped as a god in a culture of beauty.

entities.name: Llanowar
entities.description: An elvish forest whose penalty for trespassing is a bone broken for every twig snapped.

entities.name: Lys Alana
entities.description: An elvish region with Dawn's Light Palace and Wren's Run, where a huntmaster's horn sounds.

entities.name: Dawn's Light Palace
entities.description: A palace in Lys Alana with high tiers.

entities.name: Wren's Run
entities.description: A shaded part of Lys Alana.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: A power pulsing in the veins of the Stonewood Invoker, whose voice the elves hear.

entities.name: Wirewood
entities.description: A forest from which an elf runs from laughing goblins.

entities.name: Goblins
entities.description: Rock-loving creatures of Skirk Ridge, the Akki, mogg and boggart; capable of greater and worse things.

entities.name: Skirk Ridge
entities.description: A ridge from which goblins pour like lava.

entities.name: Braids
entities.description: A dementia summoner who likes the sounds goblins make when they die.

entities.name: Auntie Grub
entities.description: A goblin whose goat-and-tar mishap is a tale told of her.

entities.name: Kumano
entities.description: A teacher whose pupils each hold the strength of a landslide.

entities.name: Seton
entities.description: A centaur druid who teaches that life's lessons come from breathing and noticing.

entities.name: Frogtosser Games
entities.description: A goblin event ending in the lighting of the Flaming Boggart.

entities.name: Flaming Boggart
entities.description: A figure lit at the Frogtosser Games.

entities.name: Djinn
entities.description: A being who legend says gave the goblins a gift they could never master.

events.summary: Goblins pour from Skirk Ridge like lava, burning and devouring everything in their path.
events.quote: They poured from the Skirk Ridge like lava, burning and devouring everything in their path.

events.summary: Goblins laugh as an elf runs away, until more elves return.
events.quote: The goblins laughed as the elf ran away, until more came back.

relations.note: worshipped as a god by the elves
relations.quote: the most beautiful are worshipped as gods
They poured from the Skirk Ridge like lava
